articles.title: ON CAM: Putin Unleashes ‘SUPERWEAPON’ To DESTROY Zelensky’s Western Supply Route | Watch
articles.description: Russia is reportedly intensifying strikes on Ukraine’s Danube ports of Izmail and Reni, targeting key logistics links that connect Western military supplies to the battlefield. Military analyst Yevgeny Mikhailov, speaking to Sputnik, said the attacks could further disrupt Ukraine’s remaining supply routes through Romania and weaken the port-to-rail network used to move aid and other cargo. The strikes highlight Moscow’s broader push to hit Ukraine’s logistics infrastructure far from the front lines.

articles.title: CM Vijay Urges PM Modi To Keep Lok Sabha Strength At 543, Opposes Population-Based Delimitation
articles.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, urging the Centre to permanently fix the strength of the Lok Sabha at 543 seats. Vijay has also called for the existing state-wise distribution of Lok Sabha seats to remain unchanged and highlighted Tamil Nadu’s demand for 33 percent reservation for women in the upcoming Lok Sabha elections and subsequent Assembly polls. The demand comes amid concerns in southern states over the possible impact of population-based delimitation on their parliamentary representation.
